notes: Visual repair complete using this design’s authorized 74-frame source. Photographic world, transparent moss-covered portal, separate foliage curtains and three ordered card crops replace all former illustrations.
React/TypeScript/Tailwind stack and original scroll/parallax formulas preserved. All typography, cards, labels, buttons and controls remain live DOM.
No flattened reference screenshot or animation is used at runtime. Recovery code, source attribution, original reference and reconstruction details retained in recovery/.
Approximate areas: foliage formerly hidden by UI, manually traced alpha silhouettes, tight card crops and low-resolution softness. Original full-resolution Cloudinary files remain unavailable (401).
Production dist/index.html uses /motionsites-results/mythic-naturecore/. Original asset constants and card order preserved. Fonts bundled locally.
No deployment, push, external messages, agents, other designs, or additional sessions. Dependencies and temporary Python environment removed from delivery.
